name: Ordering Portal
one_liner: Clinic and pharmacy ordering with catalogue, credit limits and delivery tracking.
fits_when: clinics, pharmacies or hospitals order products from a priced catalogue
every order is checked against a customer's credit limit before it is fulfilled
distributors or a warehouse fulfil orders and need their own login
customers want to track shipments and see their invoices themselves
customer service needs one place to chase credit holds, delays and failed deliveries
gives_you: A product catalogue with list prices, minimum order quantities and stock status
Customer self-service: place orders, reorder, track deliveries and download invoices
Automatic credit checks with credit holds and a logged override
Distributor logins that see only their assigned orders and confirm dispatch and delivery
Shipment tracking with AWB, expected dates, proof of delivery and delay flags
An order 360 page with lines, shipments, invoices and an activity timeline

catalogue.description: A B2B ordering portal for clinics, pharmacies and hospitals: a priced product catalogue, orders checked against each customer's credit limit, distributor fulfilment and shipment tracking through to delivery and invoice. Customers and distributors sign in and see only their own records; customer service sees everything.

compliance: Orders accepted only from clinics with a verified drug licence
Credit-limit overrides logged with the user and reason
Cold-chain products flagged through dispatch and delivery
Customers and distributors see only their own orders
Audit trail of every status change and invoice
